title: The suite emits an aggregate pipeline report at a stable path
asA: downstream reader who needs the single-record verdict of a pipeline run
iWant: an aggregate report at a stable path summarising every gate's outcome and pointing at the per-gate reports
soThat: the pipeline's answer is one JSON file whose shape I can rely on across blueprint minor versions

acceptanceCriteria.description: The suite writes an aggregate report at `<reportDir>/pipeline.json` on every run. The aggregate carries `verdict`, `trigger`, `startedAt`, `endedAt`, `durationMs`, `runner.entryPoint`, and `gates[]` (each entry naming `gate`, `outcome`, `durationMs`, and `reportPath`). Template values the applying agent sets: The applying agent sets the elicited report directory; the AC substitutes the project's path for the illustrative default.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the suite has run against any tree
acceptanceCriteria.then: the file exists, its top-level keys are exactly the fixed set above, `verdict` is one of `passed` or `failed`, `gates[]` is a non-empty array in fixed configured order, and every `reportPath` value resolves to an existing per-gate report file at that relative path

acceptanceCriteria.description: The aggregate verdict is `passed` if and only if every gates[] entry's `outcome` is `passed` and no entry's outcome is `missing`.
acceptanceCriteria.given: any suite run whose gates[] array contains at least one entry with outcome `failed` or `missing`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the reviewer reads the aggregate report
acceptanceCriteria.then: the aggregate report's `verdict` field is `failed`, and the aggregate does not record `passed` while any per-gate entry recorded a non-`passed` outcome

acceptanceCriteria.description: The aggregate report writer refuses to overwrite a report path that resolves outside the elicited report directory (an attempted path traversal) with the stable code AGGREGATE_PATH_ESCAPE naming the offending path; the target file is not written.
acceptanceCriteria.given: an aggregate writer invoked with a computed path that resolves outside the elicited report-dir (a symlink loop, a path traversal ../)
acceptanceCriteria.then: the writer refuses with AGGREGATE_PATH_ESCAPE naming the offending resolution; no bytes are written to the target
